2607.15001.title: LQCDMaster: Agentic Scientific Computing for Lattice Quantum Chromodynamics Research
2607.15001.paper_summary: Lattice quantum chromodynamics (LQCD) provides a first-principles framework for computing hadronic observables, but its practical use remains limited by the substantial expertise required to turn research motivation into reliable computing workflows. Here we present \textsc{LQCDMaster}, a tool-augmented, skill-guided and domain-specialized scientific computing agent that converts natural-language LQCD research tasks into executable PyQUDA computing workflows, including measurement scripts, job-submission artifacts, execution logs and numerical outputs. The system combines agentic planning, expert-annotated LQCD skills and a deterministic Wick-contraction tool to constrain the algebraically fragile components of code generation. We evaluate \textsc{LQCDMaster} on a benchmark at the forefront of scientific research, comprising 70 LQCD computing tasks, with observables covering local and nonlocal two-point functions, Wilson loops, meson and baryon three-point functions. The generated workflows exactly reproduce expert-written implementations in 63 of 70 tasks at machine precision, with three additional discrepancies attributable to convention mismatches. Across representative observables, the agent reduces implementation time from hours to minutes while preserving end-to-end numerical validation. Further, we present a typical case of \textsc{LQCDMaster}-driven exploration: a lattice computation of light-cone distribution amplitudes with diagonal Wilson-line, a quantity accessible with standard methods but never before computed, and computation of the spectrum of proton, deuteron, triton, hyperon, hyperdeuteron and hypertriton. This work pioneers the paradigm of agentic scientific computing by automating the end-to-end scientific computing workflows in lattice QCD research, lowering its barrier and facilitating the exploration and verification of non-standard scientific ideas.
2607.15001.paper_summary_zh: 晶格量子色動力學（LQCD）提供了一個基於第一原則的框架，用於計算強子可觀測量，但其實際應用仍然受到將研究動機轉化為可靠計算工作流程所需的專業知識的限制。<lb/>在此，我們介紹\textsc{LQCDMaster}，這是一個工具增強、技能引導和領域專門的科學計算代理，能將自然語言的LQCD研究任務轉換為可執行的PyQUDA計算工作流程，包括測量腳本、作業提交文檔、執行日誌和數值輸出。<lb/>該系統結合了代理計劃、專家註釋的LQCD技能和確定性的Wick收縮工具，以約束代碼生成中代數上脆弱的組件。<lb/>我們在一個處於科學研究前沿的基準上評估\textsc{LQCDMaster}，該基準包含70個LQCD計算任務，觀測量涵蓋局部和非局部的二點函數、威爾遜環、介子和重子三點函數。<lb/>生成的工作流程在70個任務中的63個以機器精度精確重現了專家編寫的實現，另外三個差異可歸因於慣例不匹配。<lb/>在代表性觀測量中，該代理將實現時間從幾小時縮短到幾分鐘，同時保持端到端的數值驗證。<lb/>此外，我們展示了一個典型的\textsc{LQCDMaster}驅動的探索案例：使用對角威爾遜線的光錐分佈幅度的晶格計算，這是一個可以用標準方法獲得的量，但以前從未計算過，以及質子、氘、氚、重子、重氘和重氚的光譜計算。<lb/>這項工作開創了代理科學計算的範式，通過自動化晶格QCD研究中的端到端科學計算工作流程，降低了其門檻，並促進了非標準科學思想的探索和驗證。
